# ── 脱敏重构夹具 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 结构照 2026-11-16 深圳 FortiWiFi-80F-2R 实测回显重写，公网 IP、账号名与对象名已替换为 RFC 5737 文档地址与占位名，密钥已替换。
# 用途：test/forti-baseline.test.mjs 的回归基准 —— 裁剪后每条检查项的证据行必须仍在。
# 改动这里必须同步 playbooks/fortigate-audit.md 与 playbooks/fortigate-audit.checks.json。

config system global
    set admin-sport 55443
    set hostname "FWF-AUDIT-FIXTURE"
    set switch-controller enable
    set timezone 46
end

config log memory setting
    set status enable
    set max-log-file-size 0
end

config system admin
    edit "admin"
        set accprofile "super_admin"
        set vdom "root"
        set password ENC AK1jFAKEENCadmin
    next
    edit "ops-admin-2"
        set accprofile "super_admin"
        set vdom "root"
        set password ENC AK1jFAKEENCops2
    next
    edit "ops-admin-3"
        set accprofile "super_admin"
        set vdom "root"
        set password ENC AK1jFAKEENCops3
    next
end

config system interface
    edit "wan1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 192.168.201.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping
        set role wan
        set snmp-index 2
        set uuid 0d6bd8e0-1111-2222-3333-444455556666
    next
    edit "wan2"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.10 255.255.255.192
        set allowaccess ping
        set role wan
        set snmp-index 4
    next
    edit "lan"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 192.168.100.254 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh snmp http fabric speed-test
        set type switch
        set color 1
    next
    edit "wifi1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 192.168.101.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type vap-switch
    next
    edit "MIG-TMP"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 192.168.103.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type vap-switch
        set snmp-index 12
    next
    edit "fortilink"
        set vdom "root"
        set fortilink enable
        set ip 10.255.1.1 255.255.255.0
        set type aggregate
    next
    edit "inside_server"
        set vdom "root"
        set fortilink enable
        set ip 192.168.102.1 255.255.255.0
        set vlanid 12
    next
    edit "wifi"
        set vdom "root"
        set type vap-switch
        set status down
    next
    edit "internal1"
        set vdom "root"
    next
end

config system snmp community
    edit 1
        set name "public"
        set query-v1-status enable
        config hosts
            edit 1
                set source-ip 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
            next
            edit 2
                set ip 192.168.100.119 255.255.255.255
            next
        end
    next
end

config system ntp
    set ntpsync enable
    set type fortiguard
    set syncinterval 60
    set authentication disable
end

config system dns
    set primary 192.168.100.253
    set secondary 223.5.5.5
    set timeout 1
    set dns-cache-limit 0
end

config system dhcp server
    edit 1
        set interface "lan"
        set dns-service local
        config ip-range
            edit 1
                set start-ip 192.168.102.100
                set end-ip 192.168.102.199
            next
        end
        config reserved-address
            edit 3
                set ip 192.168.102.200
                set mac d4:11:22:33:44:55
            next
        end
    next
end

config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "Default Policy"
        set srcintf "lan" "inside_server"
        set dstintf "GlobalNet" "LocalNet"
        set action accept
        set utm-status enable
        set ssl-ssh-profile "custom-deep-inspection"
        set application-list "default"
        set auto-asic-offload disable
        set logtraffic all
        set nat enable
    next
    edit 2
        set name "ARMT_Office"
        set srcintf "wifi1"
        set dstintf "LocalNet"
        set action accept
        set utm-status enable
        set auto-asic-offload disable
    next
    edit 14
        set name "Drop-bad-host"
        set srcintf "lan"
        set dstintf "LocalNet" "lan"
        set dstaddr "host-object-1"
        set logtraffic all
    next
    edit 15
        set name "Guest"
        set srcintf "wifi2"
        set dstintf "LocalNet" "lan"
        set action accept
        set logtraffic all
        set nat enable
    next
    edit 16
        set status disable
        set srcintf "lan"
        set dstintf "any"
        set nat enable
    next
    edit 19
        set srcintf "inside_server"
        set dstintf "lan"
        set action accept
        set logtraffic disable
    next
    edit 24
        set name "ARMT_Guest-220-230"
        set srcintf "wifi2"
        set dstintf "lan"
        set dstaddr "ARMT_Net_220_230"
        set action accept
        set nat enable
    next
    edit 25
        set srcintf "wifi1"
        set dstintf "wifi2"
        set action accept
        set logtraffic disable
    next
end

config firewall address
    edit "host-object-1"
        set subnet 203.0.113.20 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "ipsec-to-BJ_local"
        set subnet 10.101.64.0 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "ARMT_Net_220_230"
        set type iprange
        set start-ip 192.168.100.220
        set end-ip 192.168.100.230
    next
    edit "test"
    next
    edit "tradingview-main"
        set type fqdn
        set fqdn "www.tradingview.com"
        set allow-routing enable
    next
end

config firewall vip
    edit "test_60e"
        set extip 192.168.100.254
        set extintf "any"
        set portforward enable
        set mappedip "10.60.1.1"
        set extport 60111
        set mappedport 443
    next
    edit "SSH-221-65222"
        set extip 203.0.113.10
        set extintf "wan2"
        set portforward enable
        set mappedip "192.168.100.221"
        set extport 65222
        set mappedport 22
    next
    edit "SSH-228-65322"
        set extip 203.0.113.10
        set extintf "any"
        set mappedip "192.168.100.228"
        set extport 65322
        set mappedport 22
        set status disable
    next
end

config system sdwan
    set status enable
    config zone
        edit "virtual-wan-link"
        next
        edit "GlobalNet"
        next
        edit "LocalNet"
        next
    end
    config members
        edit 2
            set interface "wan1"
            set zone "LocalNet"
            set cost 20
        next
        edit 4
            set interface "wan2"
            set zone "LocalNet"
            set cost 10
            set gateway 203.0.113.1
        next
    end
    config health-check
        edit "Default_Gmail"
            set server "gmail.com"
            set interval 1000
            set failtime 2
        next
        edit "Default_Google Search"
            set server "www.google.com"
        next
        edit "Default_Office_365"
            set server "www.office.com"
        next
    end
end

config router static
    edit 2
        set sdwan-zone "LocalNet"
    next
    edit 5
        set dst 8.8.8.8 255.255.255.255
        set gateway 192.168.201.254
        set device "wan1"
        set distance 1
    next
    edit 6
        set dst 1.1.1.1 255.255.255.255
        set gateway 192.168.201.254
        set device "wan1"
        set distance 1
    next
    edit 7
        set dst 9.9.9.9 255.255.255.255
        set gateway 192.168.201.254
        set device "wan1"
        set distance 1
    next
    edit 9
        set dst 10.128.128.0 255.255.255.0
        set gateway 192.168.100.252
        set device "lan"
    next
    edit 11
        set dst 198.51.100.254 255.255.255.255
        set gateway 192.168.201.254
        set device "wan1"
        set distance 1
        set status disable
    next
end

config wireless-controller vap
    edit "ARMT_Office"
        set ssid "ARMT_Office"
        set security wpa2-only-enterprise
        set pmf disable
        set vlanid 0
        set auth usergroup
        set usergroup "wifi_user"
    next
    edit "ARMT_Guest"
        set ssid "ARMT_Guest"
        set security wpa2-only-personal
        set pmf disable
        set passphrase ENC AK1jFAKEENCpsk
    next
    edit "ARMT_IOT"
        set ssid "ARMT_IOT"
        set security wpa2-only-personal
        set pmf disable
        set broadcast-ssid disable
    next
    edit "MIG-TMP"
        set ssid "MIG-TMP"
        set security wpa2-only-personal
        set pmf disable
        set status enable
    next
end

config wireless-controller wtp-profile
    edit "FWF-default"
        set comment "default"
        set ap-country CN
    next
end

config user radius
end

config user group
    edit "wifi_user"
        set member "zhangjing" "panjiyuan" "yangming" "caoyi" "Mi" "baojunnan" "zhangxiangyan"
    next
end

config firewall ssl-ssh-profile
    edit "custom-deep-inspection"
        config https
            set ports 443
            set status certificate-inspection
        end
        config quic
            set status bypass
        end
        config ssh
            set status disable
        end
    next
end

config application list
    edit "default"
        set other-application-log enable
        set unknown-application-log enable
        config entries
            edit 1
                set category 2 6 7
                set log enable
            next
            edit 2
                set category 8 12 15 23
                set log enable
            next
            edit 3
                set application 16882 16883
                set log enable
            next
        end
    next
end

config ips sensor
    edit "default"
        set comment "default sensor"
        set status disable
        config entries
            edit 1
                set severity high critical
                set status disable
            next
            edit 2
                set severity medium
                set log enable
                set status disable
            next
        end
    next
end

config system replacemsg admin "admin-login"
    set buffer "<html><head><title>Login</title><style>body{font-family:sans-serif}</style></head><body><form method=post><input name=username><input name=secret type=password></form></body></html>"
    set header http
end

config system replacemsg admin "auth-fortitoken"
    set buffer "<html><head><title>Two-factor</title></head><body><p>Enter your token</p><form method=post><input name=token></form></body></html>"
    set header http
end

config system replacemsg alertmail "alertmail-lib"
    set buffer "%%HOSTNAME%% alert %%ALERTTYPE%% at %%DATE%% %%TIME%%: %%LOGMESSAGE%%"
    set charset utf-8
    set format text
    set subject "Alert from %%HOSTNAME%%"
end

config vpn certificate local
    edit "Fortinet_SSL"
        set private-key "-----BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY-----\nMIIEpAIBAAKCAQEAfakefakefake\n-----END ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY-----\n"
        set certificate "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nMIICfakecert\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n"
    next
end

config vpn ipsec phase1-interface
